note: T-124 profiles, made the default by T-166 (owner decision 2026-11-20): shot_render.py and run_shot.py use 'default_profile' unless --profile names another. 'legacy128' is the previous final preset (128 spp, adaptive 0.01, the shot's own resolution); pin it by name where a golden depends on it. 'encode' holds the delivery encodes (run_shot --codec): HEVC 10-bit by default, H.264 8-bit as the compatibility fallback; masters stay lossless PNG.

final720.description: Final delivery 1280x720: 128 spp + OIDN with a looser adaptive-sampling threshold (0.05). T-124 s010_verbs frame 65: 208 s vs 433 s for the current settings (-52%), 39.4 dB vs 41.2 dB against a 512 spp reference.

review.description: Review renders 1280x720: 16 spp + OIDN, adaptive 0.05. T-124 s010_verbs frame 65: about 67 s (-84%); noisier fibres and softer hair edges, for animation/timing review only.

legacy128.description: Previous final preset, kept selectable by name: 128 spp + OIDN, adaptive threshold 0.01, resolution from the shot/bake. T-124 s010_verbs frame 65: 433 s at 1280x720, 41.2 dB vs a 512 spp reference.

hevc10.description: HEVC 10-bit 4:2:0 (x265 slow, CRF 18); T-124: about -20% bitrate at matched SSIM and 1.5-2 dB less banding than H.264 8-bit.
